question: Will Bitcoin reach or exceed $64,500 by Aug 24, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase reaches or exceeds $64,500.00 at any point from Aug 15, 2026, 12:27 UTC (market open) up to and including the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase remains below $64,500.00 at all times from Aug 15, 2026, 12:27 UTC (market open) up to and including the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches or exceeds" means any single traded spot price (last trade price) of BTC-USD on Coinbase is greater than or equal to $64,500.00 at any moment during the observation window defined above, not solely at the moment of settlement.
